prior.source: imageID of the running in-falcone-staging/falcone-web-console pods and the ghcr.io manifest for the tag

recovery: Redeploy the previous chart together with prior.digest through the deterministic Helm adapter. No runtime flag, path or environment switch serves the legacy console; the shared console-api session format keeps existing sessions valid across the rollback.

switch_release.note: Created only when release-images builds the merged cutover commit. The operator records it here after the image is published, as part of the staging rollback rehearsal.
